capabilities: browse album collections as cover cards on a shelf
play audio from local vault files or NetEase, QQ Music, and Kugou accounts
import albums from local audio files, online search, or album links
append timestamped listening entries to album notes
track playback statistics with a calendar heatmap and export to a note
extras: Desktop only. Online sources use unofficial platform APIs and playback depends on account permissions and platform availability; the README warns users to exclude the plugin's credential files from cloud-drive sync tools.
motivation: The author believes music and notes have a natural affinity: 'A song is worth writing down' and memories tied to music should stay as private pages in your own notes rather than social posts.
problem: Obsidian has no way to keep a music collection in the vault, play it, or tie listening notes and playback history to the album they came from.

relations.evidence: The local gateway uses some API modules from NeteaseCloudMusicApi, which is released under the MIT license.
The hand-drawn strokes in the tutorial (dashed boxes, ring, arrows) use roughjs, the same engine Excalidraw uses internally (MIT).

requires.name: NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, or Kugou account
Mobile NetEase/QQ/Kugou app for QR-code sign-in

summary: Album shelf and vinyl-turntable player that treats each album as a Markdown note and plays local audio or NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and Kugou accounts.
